subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Third graders read science, history, and how-to texts and understand them, using all their skills: finding the main idea and key details, figuring out word meanings, and seeing connections between ideas. Good readers reread and check the text when they are unsure.

items.prompt:
Read.

Honeybees live in groups called colonies. Each colony has one queen, many workers, and some drones. The workers gather nectar and make honey.

What is the main idea?

steps: I ask what the whole text is about.
It explains how honeybees live in colonies with different jobs.
So the main idea is how honeybees live and work in colonies.
solution.answer: Honeybees live in colonies where bees have different jobs.

items.prompt:
Read (same text).

Which bees make the honey?

steps: I find the detail about making honey.
The text says the workers make honey.
So the workers make the honey.

items.prompt:
Read.

Long ago, people used candles for light. Then the light bulb was invented, and homes became much brighter.

What changed how homes were lit?

steps: I look for the cause of the change.
So the light bulb changed how homes were lit.
solution.answer: The invention of the light bulb.

items.prompt:
Read.

Spiders are not insects. Insects have six legs, but spiders have eight.

How many legs do spiders have?

Read.

The Nile is a very long river in Africa. It gave ancient people water and food.

Where is the Nile?
When unsure of an answer, a good reader will ____ the text.
